row.category: Vertical SaaS (Healthcare, Education, Real Estate, Construction, Field Service)
row.team_price_text: Point of Sale: starting at $69/month per location
row.evidence: Toast's SSO article says SSO is "limited to select users at this time" and that "Removing a login from the organization does not automatically remove the user from Toast"; no SCIM is documented.
row.notes: Status unchanged (none). Since June, Toast documents a limited-release SSO for Enterprise groups (Toast Web and some mobile apps). The protocol and plan are not stated, so sso_plan is null. Users are still invited, and IdP removals are not synced to Toast. Pricing is per location, not per user: Starter Kit starts at $0/month and Point of Sale at $69/month, with a payroll bundle at $69/month plus $9 per employee and Build Your Own at custom pricing. Prices apply to new single-location customers. The Starter Kit is $0 software, so the team plan is now Point of Sale rather than June's Starter Kit. Employees can be managed through the Labor API. Self-service standard API access is bought in the Toast Shop and is read-only, including labor.employees:read. Create and delete need a custom integration.
row.user_api_plan: Standard API access (Toast Shop purchase, read-only) or custom integration

plans.name: Starter Kit

plans.name: Point of Sale
plans.notes: Per-location software subscription; a bundle adding payroll is $69/month plus $9 per employee per month (c3).

limitations.text: SSO users are not deprovisioned automatically: removing the IdP login does not remove the Toast user.

user_api.plan: Standard API access (read-only, purchased in Toast Shop); write access via custom integration

capabilities.notes: Employees are restaurant staff records; 'delete' marks the record deleted and blocks login; unarchive restores archived employees. Jobs (roles) can be replaced via PUT .../jobs. Write operations are not in standard API access (read-only).

limitations.text: Self-service standard API access is read-only; creating or deleting employees requires a custom or partner integration.
